Repaint input 1 into a simple hand-painted anime game card for LIFE ARROW. Preserve its warm ivory-gray background, single diagonal wooden shaft and generous negative space. Input 2 is STYLE ONLY for broad opaque planes and economical edges, not its red arrow pose or backdrop.
Correct input 1's branch-like shape into ONE unmistakable ARROW: a small sharply pointed silver arrowhead at the UPPER RIGHT, one straight slim dark wooden shaft spanning diagonally toward LOWER LEFT, and exactly TWO soft fresh green leaves sprouting near the LOWER LEFT TAIL. The leaves replace fletching and sweep backward along the arrow's flight. Remove the upper-right leaf cluster from the target and move only two simplified leaves to the tail. Keep the head, shaft and tail connected and coherent. No branching shaft or buds along its length. Near the tail, the dry brown wood turns into pale green living tissue at the leaf roots, expressed by one broad muted green stroke. This transformation suggests dormant life awakening and flying forward. The leaves are simple rounded tapering paint shapes, not detailed botanical studies. A single faint sage-colored curved swipe behind the tail can suggest air, subordinate to the arrow. Keep arrow, two leaves and quiet backdrop as the entire composition. No bird, flower, branches, particles, debris, bow, target, human or extra objects.

Rough hand-painted anime illustration built from large connected opaque color masses with a few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade edges and quiet areas. Arrowhead two silver-gray light/shadow planes with one crisp warm-white accent. Shaft a few elongated brown/charcoal paint planes; leaves muted tender sage and slightly richer green, each with one broad shadow turn, no vein network. Selected dry broken paint endings; no uniformly traced lineart, fine strands, dense engraving, triangle mosaic, glossy 3D, photographic materials, smooth airbrush or all-over grain/canvas filters. Mostly muted warm gray and brown, green concentrated at leaf tail. Intuitive arrow silhouette and poetic new growth take priority over detail. No text, watermark, border or UI.
